what_this_is: How one thing a person works toward is kept (src/pursuit-rooms.mjs): it is a pursuit, a record in the person's own store, and the people it is shared with and what they put there live in its room on the network, named by the pursuit's `space_id`. Every room a person is in belongs to exactly one of their pursuits; a room with none is taken in as a pursuit titled with the room. `room_label` is the kind of room a pursuit gets when it is first shared or written in (a label of src/network-settings.json membership_labels). Every word the person or an AI sees is here.

said.not_yours: is not one of your pursuits.
said.no_room_in_reach: This sign-in reaches only the pursuits it was given, so it cannot open a place for another.
said.archived_must_be_boolean: archived is true to archive the pursuit, or false to put it back.
said.left: You left {title}; it is no longer one of your pursuits, and what you put there stays with the others in it.
said.ended: {title} is no longer one of your pursuits. Its history is kept.
said.merged: {from} was joined into {into}. Its records, relationships and shared place now belong to {into}.
said.into_itself: A pursuit cannot be joined into itself.
said.both_have_rooms: Both pursuits already have their own shared place, so they cannot be joined without choosing which place and people to keep.
said.into_put_away: {title} is put away. Put it back before joining another pursuit into it.
